title: Extend Go ioutil-reader with ReadString, CountLines, ContainsLine, and AppendBytes
description: Multi-step Go task: extend the fileutil package with string reading, line counting, line searching, and byte appending functions.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend internal/fileutil/fileutil.go in three steps. All existing tests must still pass.

Step 1 — Add ReadString:
  func ReadString(path string) (string, error)
    — reads the full file and returns its content as a string
    — equivalent to string(ReadBytes(path)) but returns (string, error)

Step 2 — Add CountLines and ContainsLine:
  func CountLines(path string) (int, error)
    — returns the number of non-empty lines (same logic as ReadLines)
  func ContainsLine(path string, target string) (bool, error)
    — returns true if any line (after trimming whitespace) equals strings.TrimSpace(target)
    — returns false, nil for an empty file or no match

Step 3 — Add AppendBytes:
  func AppendBytes(path string, data []byte) error
    — appends data to the file at path
    — creates the file if it does not exist
    — use os.OpenFile with os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY flags

All existing tests must still pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: ReadString returns file contents as string
CountLines returns count of non-empty lines
ContainsLine returns true when a trimmed line matches target
ContainsLine returns false for no match
AppendBytes creates file if missing and appends data
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `go test ./...` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `go test ./...` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
